Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL2403108 to include the parent and all salts. Retrieve activity provenance via the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Filter for target CHEMBL4247 and activities with standard_type IC50 and standard_units nM. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to include canonical_smiles. Do not limit rows. Do not deduplicate.
